title: Super Sentai Roguelike
author: PsychologicalStop972
selftext:
I will get back to you following the last update:

\- Rebalancing the game.

\- Stress test

\- English translation

\- Added the full screen button to be able to play in better conditions.

I have always loved Tokusatsu as well as traditional Roguelike.

No games exist on this theme, I decided to create one.

I'm not going to lie: I don't know how to program and having a full-time job as well as 2 children doesn't give me time to learn this in depth, so I used AI quite a bit for creation.

As I said, this is a traditional roguelike but a little lighter: you won't have to learn all the keys on the keyboard, just a few (by pressing "?" in the games you will be able to see them).

The GOAL: go down to the 45th basement of the base to beat the big bad! I hope you like the game and don't hesitate to give me comments to improve it.

[Super Sentai Roguelike](https://spacecobra.itch.io/super-sentai-roguelike)
